exposure: Use of the CAESARE decision-making tool
cohort: 164 patients who had a cesarean section at term due to non-reassuring fetal status (NRFS) during labor
finding: The use of the CAESARE decision-making tool was shown to potentially reduce the rate of cesarean section births for NRFS while considering the risk of neonatal asphyxiation.
mod_finding: This study suggests that use of the CAESARE decision-making tool can reduce the rate of c-sections for non-reassuring fetal status during labor.
